units.name: CompareTypedRebusAnswer
units.summary: Extract only answer bytes41..5B, skipping lowercase, spaces and controls. Search each accepted byte forward in typed text with a retained X cursor; matching does not advance X, so repeated answer letters may reuse one typed character. Extra typed letters can be skipped, but accepted answer letters must occur in order. Carry set means the accepted-byte and matched-byte counts agree; this is more permissive than exact string equality.
